definition: A buying club costs $35.00 for the year. One regularly purchased product costs $19.50 outside the club and $17.25 inside it. Ignoring tax and all other benefits, what is the minimum whole number of purchases needed for product savings to cover the membership fee?
explanation: Savings per purchase = $19.50 − $17.25 = $2.25. Required purchases = ceiling($35.00 ÷ $2.25) = 16.
